title: Red Hat Security Advisory: qemu-kvm-ma security update
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the VNC WebSocket handshake implementation of the qemu-kvm user-space component for KVM virtualization on IBM z Systems, IBM Power, and 64-bit ARM architectures. This issue is identified as CVE-2025-11234 and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Extended Lifecycle Support versions for these architectures. Red Hat has issued a security update to address this vulnerability.
